notes.title: Publisher Announcement & New Demo!
notes.notes:
[p]Gather round, Michaels...

We're THRILLED to announce that we are teaming up with famed UK publishers Super Rare Originals to release Teeto on PC and consoles! 

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/olYY9vIUIrI"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Join Teeto and Nory as they go on an action-packed adventure in a bright and colourful world, absorbing ordinary objects from the world and harnessing their powers to fight the shadow corruption.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/cba49f4f4c2b90cfbd8264e16a6c98416a002745.png"][/img][/p][p]This not enough for ya? [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2783370/Teeto/"]Then gather round as we unveil a brand new demo, out now on Steam! [/url]Explore four magical areas as Teeto and Nory begin their adventure and fight back against the shadow creatures!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/ac0677353c0c7bab950fda1392d83e55e0573b09.jpg"][/img]
Collect stars as you work through the different levels to boost your score! Several Vionites will also be scattered around each level waiting to be found, but not all of these will be a walk in the park! Some will require certain abilities and strategies in order to reach them, so keep an eye on your environment.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/afe62dfab3094b93bd1a5e332d87b47ecc05ddc6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And we can't forget about the Baby Michaels, who will be hidden in each level waiting to be reunited with Nory. Try and collect them all and find each of the variations! Outfits will also be unlockable, so you can save the world in style!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/f2b979fe8a574d7a282cb252ae2c8db6fffdfa42.png"][/img][/p][p]So what are you waiting for?! Step into our demo and wishlist Teeto, as we celebrate our newly-founded partnership with Super Rare Originals. [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2783370/discussions/0/595156583817867809/"]Full demo patch notes can be found here. [/url]

  You can also follow us at @TeetoGame on [url="https://x.com/TeetoGame"]X[/url],  [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@teetogame?lang=en-GB"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/teetogame/"]TikTok[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/teetogame.bsky.social"]BlueSky [/url]and more, as well as join our [url="https://discord.gg/8G5rpF25GQ"]Discord community[/url], too!

So all that's left to say is, thank you for your continued support and we can't wait for the road ahead with Super Rare Originals! 

- The Eat Pants Team.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Minor demo update!
notes.notes: [p]Minor update introducing some different types of stars to collect with each level having a star threshold you have to meet as an extra objective for 100%'ing that level. Even though currently in the demo you can't buy any of the costumes or upgrades yet (CAUSE YOU GET IT ALL FOR FREE YOURE WELCOME)[/p][p][/p][p]We've also spruced up a tiny bit of the UI making things a little bit juicier (who doesn't love that).[/p][p][/p][p]Apparently with some controllers it was bugging out and causing the game to go into co-op mode when trying to jump about. This has been patched. Before it was picking up that if Player 2 was pressing A, they could automatically join the game. We've dropped this for now while we figure out what's up, so for now you can enable co-op in the start/pause menu :)[/p][p][/p][p]If you notice anything else - please let us know! We've got a Discord for easy access: [url="https://discord.gg/cgYdDNgkbh"]https://discord.gg/cgYdDNgkbh[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Love ya'll [/p][p]EPG[/p]

notes.title: Demo update is live!
notes.notes:
This update is the biggest yet - packed with improvements based on community feedback and our own mission to deliver the most joyful experience possible. Here’s what’s new:
[list]
[*] Brand New Camera System: Enjoy buttery-smooth platforming with our new following camera system, designed to keep gameplay intuitive and comfortable.
[*] Major Optimizations: We’ve tightened up performance across the board, ensuring a more responsive and stable experience on a wider range of hardware.
[*] Updated Visuals: Sharper visuals, better lighting, and more vibrant environments bring the world of Teeto to life like never before.
[*] Quality-of-Life Fixes: From gameplay polish to smoother movement and interaction, we’ve made dozens of small (but mighty!) adjustments to improve the overall feel of the game.
[*] New Animations & NPC Interactions: Teeto’s world is livelier than ever, with more personality-packed animations and fresh dialogue from the charming characters you’ll meet.
[/list]
     
Also made a separate demo page on Steam so if you enjoyed it - support us with a lil review!

notes.title: Controller fix!
notes.notes:
We recently received a few reports of players not being able to play the demo with their controller - the game simply wasn't recognising it. Absolute tragedy. The issue was if you were to use Steams Input override, it would cause the game to not recognise your controller.

Apparently it's been happening for a long time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/9f78a83474e6a346746f46a38920692edd917544.gif[/img]

BUT DON'T WORRY IT'S FINE. Turns out - was some annoying Steam Input settings with the demo, and now you should be able to enjoy the game with a controller (as it was intended), regardless of your Steam Input Override options. Huzzah!

P.s. very sorry and mad respect to ya'll who played on a mouse and keyboard.

notes.title: Big Teeto updates!
notes.notes:
It's been a big couple of months for the little team at Eat Pant Games.

The Teeto demo had just received a huge update, overhauling all of the UI and branding in the game. We've had big updates to the character and camera controller, animations, music tracks, graphics and a huge list of bug fixes. 

As we continue developing the game, we're looking to release another significant update to the demo early next year focusing on co-op play and story elements. Stay tuned!

We're thrilled to announce that we've received a grant from CODE in New Zealand and we'd love to again shout out the fantastic team there and all the help we've had so far. We were also finalists in this years Kiwi Game Starter which is incredibly awesome. 

Thanks to everyone who has wishlisted the game or played the demo! To keep up with development, or to let us know directly any cool things you wish to see in the game (or things we could be doing a lot better!) - join our Discord! https://discord.gg/cgYdDNgkbh

notes.title: Welcome to Shadowtown!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=6RVv4pNNRRI;full][/previewyoutube]

The new level "Welcome to Shadowtown" has been added to the demo for Teeto. In this level, Teeto and Nory find themselves atop high rise city buildings, exploring, collecting and platforming as usual. However, this level takes a mighty twist when all of a sudden you a sprung into a big musical chase section, where you have to dive and dodge to the rhythm of the music!

Included in this update is a variety of quality of life changes, bug fixes, and general improvements in gameplay and optimisations. We would love for you all to check it out and provide any feedback to our Discord!

Enjoy!!
